variants.name: Everyday
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: polished 2D full-body character concept sheet for the user's original character Nova, a future cel-shaded 3D VTuber avatar. This is a visual design proposal, not a finished rig or exact orthographic blueprint.
Input images, in supplied order: Image 1 is the PRIMARY identity and art-style reference, the close-up portrait Nova made of herself. Preserve that character's face, expression vocabulary and colors. Images 2 and 3 are SECONDARY early prototypes: borrow only a small amount of mischievous confidence and understated technical flavor, NOT their chibi proportions, dark skin, busy patches, naked torso, glowing chest vortex, excessive circuitry or big crystal jewelry.
Shared identity locked across the sheet: clearly adult woman with an athletic, slightly androgynous tomboy silhouette and relaxed, unforced confidence; natural adult anime proportions about 6.5 to 7 heads tall. Light cool periwinkle/icy-blue skin as in PRIMARY image, vibrant orange amber eyes with a narrow stylized vertical pupil, violet asymmetrical short shaggy hair with swept fringe and violet/lavender ends. Retain the distinctive dark swept-back pointed ear/fin shapes with a restrained cyan inner accent from the PRIMARY image. The face should unmistakably resemble that portrait, angular but friendly, a little knowing smirk rather than a manic grin. Both eyes visible enough for future expressive facial animation; practical clumps of hair. A tiny hint of a canine tooth in the smiling close-up is okay. Do not make her human-skinned, a child, a pin-up, hyper-muscular or a giant-headed goblin.
Art direction: excellent professional anime character development, crisp purposeful linework, controlled cel shading and tasteful dimensional form, comparable finish to the primary portrait but expanded thoughtfully to full body. Dark navy/charcoal clothes, restrained cyan trim, violet hair and orange eyes. Detail concentrated on the face, collar, a few functional garment seams and one subtle identity accent. No patch collage, floating holograms, magical effects, weapons, armor suit, huge pauldrons, capes, dangling cables, excess belts, cleavage or exposed chest energy core.
Layout: one landscape concept sheet, clean light gray-lavender background, generous margins. A large complete head-to-toe three-quarter FRONT view dominates the left half; both hands and shoes clearly visible, relaxed balanced stance, simple silhouette and believable five-fingered hands. On the right, a generous close-up of the face and shoulders above a smaller fully visible BACK view of the SAME outfit and SAME hair. Keep clothing construction, ear design and palette consistent between views. No scene or furniture. Clear modest design label only as specified below; no fake technical notes or extra text.
Design for eventual animation: easy-to-read silhouette, face unobscured, separated hair tufts, visibly separate jacket/underlayer/trousers/shoes, modest asymmetry without clutter; joints can bend without decorative obstacles.
Direction A, the closest and recommended baseline: a neat short dark-navy bomber/utility jacket ending at the upper hip, a low standing collar with a small folded hood, restrained cyan piping around collar and zipper, sleeves casually pushed to just below elbows. A charcoal crew-neck shirt fully covers the torso. One understated simple violet geometric mark on a sleeve, no readable branding. Dark tapered cargo trousers with only two shallow functional pockets and clean knee seams; sturdy streamlined mid-top charcoal sneakers with small cyan sole accents. One very faint short cyan circuit trace near a wrist, leaving face and most blue skin clean. Hair remains the primary portrait's violet shag, swept fringe, casual rather than spiky. Grounded, capable, approachable; easy slight hip shift, arms relaxed and hands outside pockets. A soft mischievous half smile, not an exaggerated action pose. Exact sheet label: "A / EVERYDAY".
